system.description:
Materials: Sheet iron or steel; polished concave metal reflector; thick convex glass lens.

Physical Description: A boxy or cylindrical metal container dominated by a single, protruding, bulbous glass lens on its front face. The interior features a highly polished silver or brass mirror positioned directly behind the flame to direct the light, while a hinged door on the back allows access to the oil chamber and wick.

Duration: 6 hours per flask of oil
